The provided onboarding document does not contain specific information about the token usage display labels or this feature request.

**Best Guess / Context:**  
In Hermes Agent, each turn sends the current conversation context along with the full tool schema (~45 tools), causing per-call context to be relatively high (e.g., ~40k+ tokens). The session metrics accumulate input tokens across all turns, which can lead to high total cumulative counts (e.g., multiple millions over long sessions). Renaming or splitting the metrics into "Total input tokens sent this session" and "Current context sent per call" would help clarify the difference between cumulative session usage and active per-turn payload size.
